title: The Forgotten Bunker
summary: A faint, repeating signal hints at a second vault that appears on no Haven Deep map. Following it leads to Vault 12, sealed from the inside, and to records that could explain the collapse — and implicate Haven Deep's own founders. Whether the truth is shared or buried is up to the survivors.

beats.title: A signal in the static
beats.description: Someone — or something — is still transmitting.

beats.title: The search
beats.description: Scouts follow the signal across dangerous ground.

beats.title: The sealed door
beats.description: Vault 12's blast door is welded shut from within.

beats.title: The Halcyon logs
beats.description: The vault's archive explains the collapse.

beats.title: Reckoning with the founders
beats.description: If the truth is out, Haven Deep must face what its founders knew.

possibleOutcomes: The truth about Project Halcyon becomes common knowledge and reshapes how survivors see the old world.
A small circle keeps the secret, and the archive becomes a source of hidden power.
The signal is never followed, and Vault 12 stays a rumour.
